messages:
nina: Noticed multiple support tickets where folks paste logs and the quickstart paginator shows a flood of retries after a 429. Quick reproduction in node: run bulk-embeds with default config and youll see repeated attempts despite Retry-After.

tom: Hmm, is the issue the retry logic (ignoring header) or the concurrency model?

nina: Both. The paginator sits at 12 parallel fetches by default and its retry handler just requeues immediately. Also we surface no guidance in the quickstart README.

ci-bot: rolling patch queued: branch fix/paginator-retry-honor (CI #914)

tom: Proposed quick fixes: reduce parallel default to 4, add honorRetryAfter flag, and implement jittered expo backoff. Keep defaults conservative for onboarding.

nina: Additionally, can we add telemetry events when a client sees 3+ 429s in 30s? That will let us identify apps that need sampleapp tuning vs product-side soft limits.

docs-bot: Suggestion: add a small "Client throttling patterns" section under /docs/inference/rate-limits. I can open a draft PR.

tom: Also a parity note: python SDK already has a `rateLimit` option per-route. Node needs an equivalent. Filed issue #419.

nina: I'll push the quickstart PR today with tests that mock Retry-After both in seconds and HTTP-date formats.

ci-bot: CI passed for fix/paginator-retry-honor (build #914) :white_check_mark:

nina: PR merged. doc PR incoming. Closing loop.
